neighbours.label: two things: Norway and Norwegians (Oslo, Bergen, Norwegian salmon, Norway) and the PostgreSQL Python driver psycopg; Sweden, Denmark and other database drivers stay low
fire: Ferries sail up the fjords north of Bergen.
As everyone knows, Norwegian salmon is exported around the world.
The opera house in Oslo slopes into the water.
Oil wealth made Norway one of the richest countries.
Fishermen in northern Norway hang cod to dry.
Even now, install psycopg2 before connecting to the database.
The script imports psycopg and opens a connection to Postgres.
In the end, use psycopg's cursor to run the query.
quiet: Ferries sail up the lakes north of Stockholm.
As everyone knows, Danish bacon is exported around the world.
The opera house in Copenhagen sits on the water.
Oil wealth made Kuwait one of the richest countries.
Fishermen in northern Scotland hang cod to dry.
Even now, install pymysql before connecting to the database.
The script imports sqlite3 and opens a connection to the file.
In the end, use pymongo's client to run the query.
